configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after both full batches and their Azure verifications. The missing-clock CatBoost improves forward but regresses seasonal; the scaled combination improves seasonal more strongly than forward. No cross-campaign mixture score has been computed. Test a bounded common-weight combination before closing these model branches.
configuration.selection: Evaluate all eight fixed combinations on both complete original folds. Require at least 0.5% lower complete RMSE than v6 on EACH fold, then lowest equally weighted mean ratio. Both preceding batches selected no candidate. No airport weights or altered thresholds. Otherwise retain v6.

refit_rule: Active new components use ties-to-even rounded medians of their two original October-selected counts; refit January-November while protecting all December flight groups. Imported v6 models remain unchanged.
